channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Dwane Casey | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Dwane Casey from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Isaiah Stewart on Dwane Casey
item.description:
James Edwards III:Isaiah Stewart:

“Coach Casey had a huge impact on this group. To have him as a first coach, it was a blessing. He knew how to work with us. He allowed us to make mistakes and play through them. To have that your first three years in the league, that's a blessing.”

Isaiah Stewart on Dwane Casey, Apr 10, 2023. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Marvin Bagley III on Dwane Casey
item.description:
Omari Sanfoka II:Marvin Bagley III on Dwane Casey stepping down:

“I enjoyed my time that I had here under Casey. Whoever comes in, it’ll be new. I’ve been through it. I’ve had a new coach four of my five years,so I know how it feels and have been through it. For a lot of the guys, it’ll be new.”

Marvin Bagley III on Dwane Casey, Apr 10, 2023. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Stanley Johnson on Dwane Casey
item.description:
“(Dwane) Casey is amazing. Everything over there is great, we just didn't figure it out. I'm 26. I'd love to right the wrong. Detroit loved on me crazy. The organization did too. I had a lot of growing up and trauma to deal with at 18/19 (years old).”

Stanley Johnson on Dwane Casey, Nov 22, 2022. Source: Detroit News.

item.title: Cade Cunningham on Dwane Casey
item.description:
“You have to be locked in; your whole team has to be locked in. You have to take every possession seriously. I was just talking to Coach Casey about it. … I feel like there are so many games where you’re like, ‘Dang, this team stole that win from us, they stole that game from us.’ Over the course of a season, you look back, and there are so many games that were stolen from you. You’re games behind now, and it’s tough to make that up. “It is hard to win, but I’m excited for next year and trying to practice that desperation every night of trying to get a win and, every possession, making the best play possible.”

Cade Cunningham on Dwane Casey, Apr 13, 2022. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Cory Joseph on Dwane Casey
item.description:
James Edwards III:Cory Joseph:

“Casey is amazing. I feel like he doesn't get the credit he deserves from the outside looking in. He regularly spends time with players, whether individually, with coaches to make this thing move. People don't see that behind the scenes.”

Cory Joseph on Dwane Casey, Apr 11, 2022. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Cade Cunningham on Dwane Casey
item.description:
#PistonsCade Cunningham on what he's learned from Dwane Casey:

“I've learned a lot. He's always talking to me about my game management,just how I control the floor and how I'm able to get other guys involved and get guys going. I try to be an extension of him when I can.”

Cade Cunningham on Dwane Casey, Feb 19, 2022. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Troy Weaver on Dwane Casey
item.description:
Omari Sanfoka II:Troy Weaver on Dwane Casey's extension:

“It was extremely important that we extend coach. It was an important part of everything we're doing,we want him to be lined up with this restoration.”

Troy Weaver on Dwane Casey, May 13, 2021. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Troy Weaver on Dwane Casey
item.description:
Rod Beard:#Pistons Troy Weaver on Dwane Casey:

“I absolutely believe and trust that we have the best coach in the world for what we're going through.”

Troy Weaver on Dwane Casey, Mar 9, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Dennis Smith Jr. on Dwane Casey
item.description:
Omari Sanfoka II:Dennis Smith Jr. on Dwane Casey:

“He's never given up on us. He always believes in us. You can't ask for more from a coach”

Dennis Smith Jr. on Dwane Casey, Feb 27, 2021. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Jerami Grant on Dwane Casey
item.description:
“I think that gives you a better connection, makes it a little easier and makes you feel better about yourself when you have people that look like you around.“Being around Troy, knowing how Troy is, what he stands for … meeting Coach Casey and understanding how he is, that played a big role in it. I know what Troy stands for and how he’s going to move throughout his tenure here.”

Jerami Grant on Dwane Casey, Jan 6, 2021. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Isaiah Stewart on Dwane Casey
item.description:
James Edwards III:Isaiah Stewart on vibe he got from Detroit during interviews:

“When I met with them ... it was definitely different. Troy and Coach Casey told me their vision and what they wanted to do. They felt I fit their vision and I felt that way, too.”

Isaiah Stewart on Dwane Casey, Jan 2, 2021. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Josh Jackson on Dwane Casey, Troy Weaver
item.description:
Rod Beard:#Pistons Josh Jackson on coming to Detroit with Troy Weaver and Dwane Casey:

“It just felt right... It was really easy for me to make that decision.”

Josh Jackson on Dwane Casey, Troy Weaver, Dec 2, 2020. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Killian Hayes on Dwane Casey
item.description:
Killian Hayes:

“I'm excited for Detroit. I had a long talk with Coach Casey and Troy. I'm excited to meet everyone and get on the court.”

Killian Hayes on Dwane Casey, Nov 18, 2020. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Blake Griffin on Dwane Casey
item.description:
“I look for our team to be competitive. I know from my conversations with Coach [Dwane Casey] and Troy and the front office, they want to put a competitive team on the floor,”

Blake Griffin on Dwane Casey, Aug 14, 2020. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Tom Gores on Dwane Casey
item.description:
“At a high level, we’ll work all this out in the detail. Really, Troy, and Ed and Dwane will work on a day-to-day basis with each other, and Troy will have normal — and even higher than normal — GM responsibilities and he’s got a lot to learn. He’s going to get on the ground and know each player well and connect with (Casey) and so on and then as it bubbles up to ownership, Arn and I — if there's big decisions that need to be made — we’ll all gather.”

Tom Gores on Dwane Casey, Jun 27, 2020. Source: Detroit News.

item.title: Tom Gores on Dwane Casey
item.description:
team owner Tom Gores said this week.

“We just felt it was time to go big or go home. Let’s just go get the best. We have a great coach ready to go. Dwane (Casey) and Troy have a great chemistry that they’ve built — that was important to me.”

Tom Gores on Dwane Casey, Jun 27, 2020. Source: Detroit News.

item.title: Bruno Caboclo on Dwane Casey
item.description:
Caboclo spent most of the next four years developing with Toronto’s D League affiliate, helping that squad win a D League title in '17 but playing just 25 games for an ascending Raptors team over the course of his rookie contract.

“When I got on the Raptors, Coach [Dwane] Casey was playing 7 or 8 players a game. They weren’t looking to me very much,”

Bruno Caboclo on Dwane Casey, May 24, 2020. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: Masai Ujiri on Dwane Casey
item.description:
Masai Ujiri:

“With Casey, it has gotten so much better now with his family and him. With DeMar there is still plenty of work to be done. But, by the grace of God, it will all get better. We have to continue to make theses decisions that are tough. But that's the business of basketball, and the position that we are in.”

Masai Ujiri on Dwane Casey, Apr 13, 2020. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Dwane Casey
item.description:
Jared Weiss:Brad Stevens:

“I love Coach Casey. I love his teams. They play hard. They always come at you.”

Brad Stevens on Dwane Casey, Jan 15, 2020. Source: Twitter @JaredWeissNBA.

item.title: Tom Gores on Dwane Casey
item.description:
Pistons owner Tom Gores said Jan. 2.

“That’s what we’re aspiring to — something bigger than what we’ve been doing, but I haven’t lost faith in what (Pistons coach Dwane Casey) is doing and how we’re developing the players and our future.”

Tom Gores on Dwane Casey, Jan 11, 2020. Source: Detroit Free Press.

item.title: Derrick Rose on Dwane Casey
item.description:
#PistonsDerrick Rose on expectations from coach Dwane Casey:

“The special thing about this situation is what they’re asking me to do, I naturally play that way. They want me to get in the paint and create– and that’s what I’ve been doing since sixth grade.”

Derrick Rose on Dwane Casey, Oct 2, 2019. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Kyle Lowry on Dwane Casey, Nick Nurse
item.description:
Lowry on Casey firing, Nurse hiring:

“I had no say in any of that. I didn't get asked. My job is to go hoop.”

Kyle Lowry on Dwane Casey, Nick Nurse, Nov 13, 2018. Source: Twitter @WolstatSun.

item.title: Kyrie Irving on Dwane Casey
item.description:
Irving also thinks the coaching change – Dwane Casey in, Stan Van Gundy out – has also aided in Blake’s strong start to the season.

“Dwane Casey has done a great job of letting Blake be Blake,”

Kyrie Irving on Dwane Casey, Oct 27, 2018. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Malik Rose on Dwane Casey
item.description:
Malik Rose:

“I really do think coach Casey has the ability to coach at a championship level and alter his coaching style to fit his team's personality and ability. That's what I think separates the good coaches from the bad coaches, the coaches that can adjust and they don't have to coach just one way. Coach Casey can coach in a myriad of ways, and he'll find the best way to coach the Pistons and put them in position to win as many games as possible, and really have a special season.”

Malik Rose on Dwane Casey, Aug 22, 2018. Source: Detroit Free Press.

item.title: Malik Rose on Dwane Casey
item.description:
Rose, who played 13 NBA seasons from 1996-2009, was a guest on SiriusXM NBA Radio, and was effusive with his praise for Casey.

“I think we really hit a home run in Detroit with getting coach Casey, I mean this is one of the best coaches in the league,”

Malik Rose on Dwane Casey, Aug 22, 2018. Source: Detroit Free Press.

item.title: Glenn Robinson on Dwane Casey
item.description:
“Coach (Dwane) Casey was the first one to call me at 12:01 the night of free agency. He had time to talk about being from the Indianapolis area,knowing my game and how I fit in at shooting guard/small forward,”

Glenn Robinson on Dwane Casey, Jul 28, 2018. Source: nwi.com.

item.title: Ed Stefanski on Dwane Casey
item.description:
“Casey knows him extremely well and has coached him. He can play with a lot of different players. He’s a very good ball-handler and a playmaker and he can make an open 3,”

Ed Stefanski on Dwane Casey, Jul 10, 2018. Source: Detroit News.

item.title: Tom Gores on Dwane Casey
item.description:
Tom Gores:

“What really drew me to Dwane Casey was that he was hungry.”

Tom Gores on Dwane Casey, Jun 20, 2018. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Tom Gores on Dwane Casey
item.description:
Tom Gores:

“As much as he brings in experience, we really wanted to make sure that he really liked this team. He knew our players, he liked the team. He really dove in over different parts so I feel like we were very fortunate, but we didn’t say ‘Dwane Casey, coach of the year, let’s just hire him.’ We really vetted it out and I think he did his homework,too. He could have taken any job he wanted next year and he could have easily waited a year, but he thought this was special.”

Tom Gores on Dwane Casey, Jun 18, 2018. Source: Detroit Free Press.

item.title: Fred VanVleet on Dwane Casey
item.description:
[...] Fred VanVleet:

“Nothing's changed for me. [Dwane Casey] was a big part of that, just my familiarity and comfort level and obviously, I was playing a lot of minutes, and, you know, a coach could come in and it may not work out that way. But I can't worry about that. I'm going to be loyal to the organization that gave me a chance and I love the city of Toronto, I love the fans, I love the people here, and I would love to be back. So hopefully it can work out. Obviously, you'd like to be wanted. You want all parties to find a way to make it work. And that's what we're gonna shoot for. We'll see what happens in the next few weeks.”

Fred VanVleet on Dwane Casey, May 18, 2018. Source: SportsNet.
